CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated Case Record Type Developer Names to include. Only cases with a matching Record Type will be evaluated by this rule. Leave blank to apply to all record types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter Record Type Developer Names separated by semicolons (;). Use the Developer Name (API name), not the display label. Example: Support_Case;Billing_Case. To find Developer Names: Setup > Object Manager > Case > Record Types. Leave blank to match all record types.
CustomField.label: Record Type Developer Names
